title: The food-safety rule
body: From next month, cooked food may leave a hostel kitchen only if it is kept below 5 °C until it is served, or served within 2 hours of cooking. The first inspection is in 30 days; a kitchen that fails is shut for a week. Annapurna's dinner is ready at 7:00 pm, so a 9:30 pm box is 2½ hours old.
